request: Add an admin-only decorator for the admin pages that redirects non-admins to the login page.

summary.result_text:
I added `admins_only` to `CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py`. It sends anyone who isn't an admin to `auth.login`, with `next` set to the requested path so they come back after logging in.

Every admin module (`users.py`, `challenges.py`, `pages.py`, `teams.py` and `admin/__init__.py`) already imported and used `admins_only`, but it wasn't defined anywhere. The admin package couldn't be imported before this. No other files needed changes.

I haven't run the tests. The test command needed your approval and didn't run. `tests/admin/test_views.py` is the quickest check.

`admins_only_api` in the same file only checks `authed()`, not `is_admin()`, so any logged-in user passes it. Nothing uses it right now. I left it alone, but you should fix it before anyone relies on it.

input.command: git ls-files | head -100 && grep -rniE "admin|login" --include=* -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -30
cat CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py | head -120; grep -n "admins_only" -r CTFd/admin | head -20; sed -n 1,60p CTFd/admin/__init__.py
sed -n 118,158p CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py; git log --oneline -3 -- CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py; grep -rn "admins_only_api" CTFd | head
